houseRules: Ours is a quiet neighbourhood and the evenings here are wonderfully serene. We kindly ask that everyone is back at the house by 10 PM. It keeps us on good terms with our neighbours and gives you the restful night you deserve after a day of exploring.
A home, not a party venue

This house is meant as a calm, intimate retreat. Please keep gatherings to your own group and avoid large get-togethers or loud events. Good conversation and laughter are always welcome — just keep it cosy.
The entire property, indoors and outdoors, is strictly non-smoking. If you do need a smoke, we kindly ask that you step outside the property gates. Thank you for understanding.
Switch off when you step out
When you head out, please turn off the lights, fans and air conditioners. A small habit that makes a real difference — to the environment and to keeping things running smoothly.
A clean kitchen is a happy kitchen
The kitchen is yours to use and enjoy. We only ask that utensils, pots, pans and dishes are washed and put back after use, so the space stays ready for your next meal.
We follow the lovely tradition of leaving footwear outside the entrance. There is a dedicated spot for shoes right at the door — step in and feel at home.
houseNotes: We rely on solar heating, so on sunny days you’ll have hot water in all bathrooms. As a backup, geysers are installed in the living room bathroom and the 1st floor bedroom bathroom. Their switches (marked 16A) are located just outside the respective bedrooms — please switch them on about 20–30 minutes before use if the solar water isn’t warm enough.

If the water flow stops, it likely means the overhead tank has run dry. Simply switch on the motor, located above the washing machine in the kitchen area. If water still doesn’t resume, please also check the corresponding switch on the MCB board.
As mentioned in the house rules, please clean vessels after use. If you’d prefer, our househelp can do this for you at a nominal charge of Rs. 100, payable directly to her.
Our househelp comes daily to clean the house. Please let us know your convenient time — we’d suggest either 7:30–8:00 AM or after 2:00 PM.
Please keep the main gate closed, especially through the night. It keeps the house secure and keeps stray animals out of the compound.
Please leave shoes and chappals in the shoe rack rather than outside the door — stray dogs in the area are known to carry footwear away.
stayText:
*Welcome in, Anita*

A few things to make the stay easy:

*Wi-Fi:* RV-Home · password *pass1234*
*Kitchen:* yours to use — we only ask that everything is washed and put back after each use.
*Stepping out:* please switch off the lights, fans and AC, and pull the door shut behind you.
*Evenings:* the neighbourhood turns in early, so do keep things quiet and plan to be back by 10 PM.
*Footwear:* there is a spot at the entrance — shoes stay outside.

The house is entirely non-smoking, indoors and out.

Anything you cannot find, just message here. Enjoy Udupi.

Anita, a small reminder that check-out is by 11:00 AM on 12 Dec 2026.

On your way out, it would help us a lot if you could:
• Switch off the lights, fans, AC and geyser

Leave the keys where you found it.

It has been lovely having you. If the stay was good to you, a review would mean a great deal — and do come back.
